A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the EEG state changes during the sleep-wake cycle are not as clear-cut and distinct as we have assumed for many years.
the EEG state is not a simple state but a state that changes continuously and in a non-linear fashion.

the EEG state dynamics are not as stable as previously thought.
